seo.title: About Travessia
seo.description: We started because a payment from London arrived R$ 600 short. Travessia is the account its founders wanted.

title: We started because a payment from London arrived R$ 600 short
lead: In 2025, our founders were still freelancers. Travessia is the account they wanted.

story.title: How we got here
paragraphs: Rafael Sato and Bia Nunes worked as designers for studios in Europe. Every invoice went through an international wire, a spread nobody explained and a tax invoice issued by hand at month end.
One month in 2025 they did the maths: a US$ 4,000 payment arrived R$ 600 below that day's commercial rate. That was the starting point.
Today Travessia has 14 people in São Paulo and Recife, and serves 2,140 accounts of Brazilian freelancers and studios with clients in 31 countries.

panels.title: What we do
items: We issue invoices in English and receive dollars, euros and pounds.
We convert to reais at a 0.6% fee, shown before you confirm.
We issue the export tax invoice with every payment.

panels.title: What we don't do
items: We don't offer credit, investments or cards.
We don't charge receiving or withdrawal fees.
We don't hold your money longer than it takes to convert.

disclaimer.title: This company does not exist
disclaimer.text: Travessia is a demo project, built to test Source by Webflow with a complete site. The people, stories, numbers and integrations on this page are made up.
disclaimer.note: No form stores data and no money is moved.
